summary: Public health laboratories in various settings, from small general hospital labs to national reference labs, use OpenELIS Global to automate work plans, import results, and support complex workflows, reducing turnaround times and increasing result accuracy for better patient care. Thousands of users rely on OpenELIS daily, primarily in national-scale settings. The system meets ISO and SLIPTA requirements for lab accreditation and adheres to strict security standards. OpenELIS supports standards-based interoperability to facilitate lab order receipt and result transmission to other systems. The software is used at a national scale, primarily benefiting public health laboratories and their users. The system's impact is focused on improving laboratory operations and patient care.
